Evidence:
[1] The album's title is a nod to the 1976 film "In the Realm of the Senses", directed by Nagisa Oshima; the title track uses samples from the film.
[2] His films include "In the Realm of the Senses" (1976), a sexually explicit film set in 1930's Japan, and "Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence" (1983), about Japanese WW2 prisoners of war.
[3] Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence (Japanese: Senjō no Merī Kurisumasu (戦場のメリークリスマス , "Merry Christmas on the Battlefield") , also known in many European editions as Furyo (俘虜, Japanese for "prisoner of war"), is a 1983 British-Japanese drama film directed by Nagisa Oshima, produced by Jeremy Thomas and starring David Bowie, Tom Conti, Ryuichi Sakamoto, Takeshi Kitano and Jack Thompson.
[4] The song is the vocal version of the theme from the Nagisa Oshima film "Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence" (in certain territories retitled "Furyo").
